entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow, easing in the south tonight and further north early Thursday morning. Snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria above 600 metres, with lesser amount down to 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Chance of upgrade reduced to low.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is easing from the south this evening and further north around midnight. Rainfall accumulations may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to develop above 800 metres early Thursday morning. 1 cm or less of snow may accumulate about the summit.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to continue until around midnight. A further 1 to 2 cm of snow may accumulate above 700 metres, with lesser amounts lower down to 400 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected above 400 metres until about midnight and 1 to 2 cm could accumulate near the summit.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Rain could turn to snow above 800 metres mid Thursday morning. Around 1 cm of snow may accumulate on the road near the summit.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to continue through to early Thursday morning. A further 2 to 4 cm of snow may accumulate above 600 metres, with lesser amounts down to 400 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 500 metres overnight. 2 to 5 cm of snow may accumulate about the summit, with lesser amounts down to 500 metres.
